name: 蕭郁達
objective:
本課程說明程序最適化的基本原理，介紹化工程序及能源系統中常見的最適化策略。內容包括：最適化理論及演算法、數學規劃與建模技巧、最適化於化工問題及能源議題之應用。
This course aims to introduce optimisation basics and common optimisation strategies in chemical processes and energy systems. The contents include optimisation theory and algorithms, mathematical programming and modelling techniques, and applications to chemical engineering problems and energy issues.
schedule:
Optimization Problems for Process Integration
Topic 1 – Heat Exchanger Network Design
Topic 2 – Water System Design
Topic 3 – Distillation Sequencing
Topic 4 – Industrial Symbiosis
Topic 5 – Multi-Energy Systems

Formulations of Optimization Problems
Topic 6 – Objective Functions and Constraints
Topic 7 – Linear Programming for Problem Solving
Topic 8 – Nonlinear Programming for Problem Solving
Topic 9 – Mixed-Integer Programming for Problem Solving
Topic 10 – Stochastic Programming and Flexibility Analysis
materials:
1. Self-made materials
2. R. Smith, “Chemical Process Design and Integration, 2nd Edition”, John Wiley & Sons, Inc., 2016.
3. J. M. Ponce-Ortega, R. Ochoa-Barragán, C. Ramírez-Márquez, “Optimization of Chemical Processes: A Sustainable Perspective”, Springer Nature, 2024.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG6：潔淨水與衛生（Clean Water and Sanitation）SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）SDG12：負責任的消費與生產（Responsible Consumption and Production）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
remarks: Prerequisite knowledge:Material and Energy Conservation, Calculus, Unit Operation
